newsitem.title: UK: NWE naphtha steady, propane keeps buyers relaxed.
newsitem.headline: NWE naphtha steady, propane keeps buyers relaxed.

text.p: NWE naphtha held steady on Tuesday, but the undertone remained soft with crude weaker and cheaper alternative feed-stocks keeping petrochemical buyers relaxed, traders said.
"Propane is quite a good alternative to naphtha at the moment although the gap is closing," a trader for a major petrochemical company said.

"If you booked the propane around two weeks ago it was worth up to around $16 but that gap is down to below $10 now and looks likely to close further," he added. Traders said good fob avails in ARA were also keeping Petrochemical buying relaxed.
One or to late April Russian cargoes were still seen after a 14kt parcel traded into Rotterdam on Monday at a weaker $180 a tonne, around $2 under it's original offer.
